headline: Oral Roberts finishes unbeaten against Summit opposition
dek: Oral Roberts's only two defeats came outside the conference, to Baylor and then to Kansas. Its defense conceded 13 goals all season, fewer than any other Summit program.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Oral Roberts alone scored more than St. Thomas, Kansas City and Omaha together.

wire.line: No Summit side beat Oral Roberts all season; its run ended with a loss at Kansas.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two matches are past their date with no result: St. Thomas's August match at Wisconsin and Idaho's September visit to South Dakota State.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: St. Thomas conceded 37 goals, more than any other Summit program.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Omaha scored eight goals all season and drew seven of its matches.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Morgan Russmann scored ten goals from 86 shots for North Dakota State.

last_match.line: Oral Roberts had gone unbeaten since losing to Baylor in September.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
